mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the new surface was most worthwhile: closing the visible gap felt like progress, while the result showed that deeper repair was still needed.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the temporary clot is mostly cleared while supporting fibres remain and the scar continues to change.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though fitting the capillary sprout was the only available combination rather than a meaningful choice.

continue.text: I would probably continue: seeing the surface close and then the blood supply reconnect made me curious about how the body changes next.
